question: A network engineer needs a tool to automate the provisioning of Cisco UCS Service Profiles. The administrator has limited programming knowledge but is skilled with scripting tools. The tool must include existing support for Cisco UCS configuration. Additionally, the administrator will eventually use the solution to manage Cisco UCS C-Series Rack Servers. Which tool meets these requirements?
theory: Cisco's UCS PowerTool Suite is a ready-made set of PowerShell cmdlets covering nearly the entire UCS Manager XML API object model, so a scripting-savvy (but not necessarily deep-programming) administrator can automate service profiles without building an SDK integration from scratch. Because the same PowerTool family also has a Cisco IMC module, it naturally extends to managing standalone C-Series rack servers later, which plain Bash/Python scripts or DCNM (a network fabric manager, not a UCS tool) don't provide out of the box. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 17 — Evaluate Automation and Orchestration Technologies)
